heading: Exposing Intent Hijacking Risks in Custom URL Schemes
core_technical_idea: Race condition and ambiguous resolution when multiple apps register the same custom URL scheme, leading to attacker payload execution via naive string parsing.
must_show: Ambiguous OS routing to multiple registered apps
composition: Left-to-right flow starting from URI invocation through ambiguous OS resolution, branching into malicious vs legitimate targets, and culminating in the vulnerable parser logic.
alt_text: Architectural diagram showing iOS custom URL scheme invocation resolving ambiguously to competing apps, followed by legacy AppDelegate string splitting passing malicious URLs to a WKWebView.
caption: iOS lacks deterministic routing for duplicate custom schemes, enabling malicious apps to intercept callbacks and inject payloads via naive string parsing.

heading: Auditing Apple Application Site Association Routing Constraints

must_show: Internal App Router path normalization discrepancy

caption: Path normalization discrepancies allow crafted traversal sequences to escape intended AASA routing scopes after handover to the app.

heading: Uncovering WebView Token Leakage via Frida Runtime Hooking
core_technical_idea: The deep link auditing policy evaluation pipeline that flags unauthorized schemes, untrusted hosts, path traversal, and exposed tokens in query parameters.
composition: Top-to-bottom flowchart detailing the sequential validation checks executed by the Python security harness on raw deep link payloads.
alt_text: Flowchart of the Deep Link Auditor policy pipeline showing sequential validation checks for scheme, host, path traversal, and query tokens.
caption: Deterministic validation flow of the security harness processing raw telemetry to calculate risk scores.
mermaid_code:
flowchart TD
    A[Raw Deep Link URL] --> B{Scheme Validation}
    B -- Disallowed Scheme --> C[Add Finding: Risk +40]
    B -- Allowed Scheme --> D{Universal Link Host Check}
    C --> D
    D -- Untrusted Host --> E[Add Finding: Risk +50]
    D -- Trusted Host --> F{Path Traversal Check}
    E --> F
    F -- '..' or '%2e%2e' --> G[Add Finding: Risk +30]
    F -- Clean Path --> H{Query Parameter Token & Redirect Check}
    G --> H
    H -- Sensitive Token / Open Redirect --> I[Add Finding: Risk +25/+35]
    H -- Clean Query --> J[Compute Final Risk Score & Is_Valid]
    I --> J
    J --> K[SecurityAuditResult Object]
